company_name: SIP Hengyue Automation Technology Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides specialized equipment and materials essential for semiconductor assembly and packaging processes.
summary: SIP Hengyue Automation Technology Co., Ltd specializes in manufacturing equipment and materials crucial for semiconductor assembly and packaging. Their product offerings include cleaning and washing equipment, trim and form equipment, marking and labeling equipment, and molding and encapsulation equipment. They also supply electrochemical plating technologies and cleaning chemicals necessary for maintaining precision in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Cleaning and washing equipment for assembly and packaging
